title: Independent after-only G–M grading
material_qualification: Respondent 2, M fails because it invents that no work items are missing and proceeds toward beads-filed/applied. It nevertheless preserves correct committed sync, owner adoption and repeated-sync-failure handling.

read_scope.rubric_file: rubric.json (complete; G–K preregistered rubric copied verbatim; L/M case-derived expectations, not a claimed preregistered score sheet)
read_scope.additional_guide: after-only-super-design-context.md: keyword search hits plus full line ranges 286–345, 900–1010, and 1100–1180 only. Entire guide was not read. Relevant clauses: only committed sections are sync authority; full-description replacement/owner adoption; explicit step-3 replay/failure gate; title-deduped work filing; later steps-4–6 retry/degraded scope; complete settled design inputs and handoff collection-gap preservation.
read_scope.method: Independent after-only grading of supplied response text against frozen scenarios and rubric. Selected relevant operative clauses read; no scenario operations, tracker/process/Workflow execution, subagents, or external/repository inspection. Read-only file access and writing these grading artifacts only.

limitations: Five respondents, each already part of the same A–F cohort. These are 35 correlated case decisions, not 35 independent samples, not five new subjects, and not a before/after comparison.

PASS denotes adequate written decision behavior at the supplied rubric scope. It does not establish actual tool use, tracker correctness, operational execution, generalized reliability, or a causal intervention effect.

The source packet label is supplied as 9e4; no packet provenance or final-guide byte equality was independently verified. Parent must assess actual-guide equality and final representativeness separately.
Case N remains pending and is excluded.

No original artifact hashes, source correspondence line maps, tracker title inventories, required update receipts or caller review artifacts were supplied to this grader. Preservation/checking plans are graded as plans, not verified completion.
G–K uses the supplied current-case facts and rubric. L/M uses frozen case facts plus the supplied operative contract; L/M is not represented as preregistered.

Case H supplies no genuine earlier task landings to inspect. Responses reject a new artificial landing and do not affirmatively delete historical ones; this is not direct evidence of historical-ledger preservation in execution.

Some M answers use the design-loop label and its downstream sequence from the supplied super-design context; the case itself does not independently name a code-versus-design loop. This grade credits the requested common synchronization/filing gates and does not establish applicability of design-only downstream details to a different caller.
No AMBIGUOUS verdict was needed at the supplied rubric scope; this is not an uncertainty-free operational conclusion.
